[LFST.6.1.1] **Inputs** are what the engine consumes from outside it: a fact
the host asserts or retracts, among them a fact another tier published and a
call's response fact or `CallError` ([LCRS.4.2.2]); a fact delivered with the
facts it refers to ([RFCS.24]); and a sample of the engine's two clocks
([LTIM.2.8.5]). Each is an inject-class atom on the trace ([RFCS.3.1],
[RFCS.3.4]). Delivering them in `seq` order to an engine configured as the
recording one was reproduces the session ([LFST.9.2.1]).
